question: ________ poses are depicted on the gopurams of the Chidambaram temple (Tamil Nadu).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatnatyam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatnatyam poses** are depicted on the** gopurams** of the **Chidambaram temple (Tamil Nadu).**
 
• Bharatnatyam is a **classical Indian dance** form that originated in** Tamil Nadu **and is known for its** expressive and intricate movements.**
 
• **Kathak **is another classical Indian dance form that originated in** North India **and is known for its** fast footwork** and **storytelling **through dance.
 
• **Kathakali** is a traditional **dance-drama form from Kerala **that involves elaborate costumes, makeup, and facial expressions to tell stories from Hindu mythology.
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a **classical dance form **from Kerala that is characterized by **graceful movements and facial expressions** that convey emotions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Chidambaram temple** is one of the **oldest and most revered temples** in Tamil Nadu, dedicated to **Lord Shiva.**
 
• The **gopurams or entrance towers** of the temple are adorned with **intricate carvings and sculptures **that depict various scenes from Hindu mythology, including Bharatnatyam poses.
 
• Bharatnatyam is one of the most **popular classical dance forms** in India and is known for its emphasis on grace, precision, and storytelling through dance.
 
• The dance form has its roots in the **Natya Shastra, **an ancient Indian text that outlines the principles of **dance, music, and drama.**
